## 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggExtra)

```

```{r}
datapisum_6<-read.csv( "../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/pisum/emmeans_pisum_6.csv")

mean(datafabae_4$emmean)
  datafabae_4<-read.csv("../../../../02.analyses/01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/fabae/emmeans_fabae_4.csv")

pisum <- datapisum_6 %>%
  dplyr::select(ivip, emmean) %>%
  dplyr::rename(larvae_pisum = emmean)

fabae <- datafabae_4 %>%
  dplyr::select(ivip, emmean) %>%
  dplyr::rename(larvae_fabae = emmean)

merged <- inner_join(pisum, fabae, by = "ivip")

```

```{r}


cor_test <- cor.test(merged$larvae_pisum, merged$larvae_fabae)
cor_test


ggplot(merged, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE  +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Larvae Counts for Shared IVIP",
    x = "Larvae Total Number (A. pisum)",
    y = "Larvae Total Number (A. fabae)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

p <- ggplot(merged, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("R = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Larvae Counts for Shared IVIP",
    x = "Larvae Total Number (A. pisum)",
    y = "Larvae Total Number (A. fabae)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



library(ggExtra)

ggMarginal(
  p,
  type = "histogram",     # or "histogram"
  margins = "both",     # X and Y
  size = 5,             # relative size of marginals
  alpha = 0.5
)

```

```{r}
ggplot(merged, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae)) + geom_point(size = 2) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + labs( title = "Correlation of Larvae Counts for Shared IVIP", x = "Larvae Total Number (Pisum)", y = "Larvae Total Number (Fabae)" ) + theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
genetic_cluster<-read.csv("../../../../00.info/11.infos_genotypes/summary_table_faba.csv")

genetic_cluster <- genetic_cluster %>%
  dplyr::select(ivip, cluster_name)



merged_cluster_fabae <- inner_join(fabae, genetic_cluster, by = "ivip")
merged_cluster_pisum <- inner_join(fabae, genetic_cluster, by = "ivip")


# Ensure cluster_name is a factor
merged_cluster$cluster_name <- as.factor(merged_cluster$cluster_name)

# Scatter plot
ggplot(merged_cluster, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae, color = cluster_name)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +  # overall regression line +          # axes start at 0
  labs(
    title = "Fabae vs Pisum Larvae Counts by Cluster",
    x = "Larvae Total Number (Pisum)",
    y = "Larvae Total Number (Fabae)",
    color = "Genetic Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```



```{r}

summary(merged_cluster)

# Remove rows where cluster_name is NA or empty/only spaces
merged_cluster <- merged_cluster[!is.na(merged_cluster$cluster_name) & 
                                 merged_cluster$cluster_name != "" &
                                 trimws(merged_cluster$cluster_name) != "", ]
merged_cluster <- droplevels(merged_cluster)
merged_cluster$cluster_name<-as.factor(merged_cluster$cluster_name)

boxplot(larvae_pisum ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster,
        main = "Box Plot by Cluster (A. pisum)",
        xlab = "Genetic cluster",
        ylab = "Fecundity score",
        las = 2,            # vertical labels
        cex.axis = 0.6)     # smaller axis text


boxplot(larvae_fabae ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster,
        main = "Box Plot by Cluster (A. fabae)",
        xlab = "Genetic cluster",
        ylab = "Fecundity score",
        las = 2,            # vertical labels
        cex.axis = 0.6)     # smaller axis text

anova_model <- aov(larvae_pisum ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster)
summary(anova_model)



library(multcomp)
posthoc <- glht(anova_model, linfct = mcp(cluster_name = "Tukey"))
summary(posthoc)



# Assign letters to groups
library(agricolae)
tukey <- TukeyHSD(anova_model)
tukey
hsd <- HSD.test(anova_model, "cluster_name", group = TRUE)
hsd$groups


anova_model <- aov(larvae_pisum ~ cluster_name, data = merged_cluster)
summary(anova_model)



library(multcomp)
posthoc <- glht(anova_model, linfct = mcp(cluster_name = "Tukey"))
summary(posthoc)



# Assign letters to groups
library(agricolae)
tukey <- TukeyHSD(anova_model)
tukey
hsd <- HSD.test(anova_model, "cluster_name", group = TRUE)
hsd$groups
```
The script used for the final figure:

```{r}

cor_test <- cor.test(merged$larvae_pisum, merged$larvae_fabae)
cor_test

ggplot(merged, aes(x = larvae_pisum, y = larvae_fabae)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("R = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Larvae Counts for Shared IVIP",
    x = expression("Adjusted mean of fecundity score" ~ italic("(A. pisum)")),
    y = expression("Adjusted mean of fecundity score" ~ italic("(A. fabae)"))
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  theme_bw()



fabae<-read.csv("../../../01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/fabae/emmeans_fabae_4.csv", sep = ",")
pisum <- read.csv("../../../01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/pisum/emmeans_pisum_6.csv", sep = ",")

ggplot(fabae, aes(x = emmean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of emmean (A. fabae)",
    x = "emmean",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


ggplot(pisum, aes(x = emmean)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    color = "black",
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of emmean (A. fabae)",
    x = "emmean",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```
